start_here: Say to your AI: "I reviewed the packet in adoption-input.json, so adopt it into my herb bed record and tell me what changed." It runs tool:adopt-reviewed-evidence-into-my-library.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it adopts a saved, reviewed input into the table, template spec and investigation record your schema names.
instructions: 1. Have a library whose schema carries a frame_evidence profile and an adoption profile, and a finalized page journal for the evidence (see tool:pin-video-frames-as-evidence-pages and the finalize-page-journal command).

2. Write the adoption input and have the person review it: {"schema": "source_evidence_adoption@1", "piece", "leaf", "spec_path", "before_spec_identity", "question_id", "journal_path", "evidence_paths", "appended_scope", "evidence_note"}. before_spec_identity must be the spec's current BLAKE3.

3. Say to your AI: "Adopt this reviewed packet". It reads the row with tools:list and runs python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library <library> --schema <schema> adopt-window adoption-input.json
4. Read the answer: question_state (preserved), source_review_kind, exact_byte_inverse_verified, the before and after identities and receipt_path. Report any refusal exactly.
5. A second adoption on the same input refuses ("Current template spec does not match the declared before-spec identity") and changes nothing; the pre-images and receipt are never overwritten.

worked_examples.title: A finalized page journal adopted as source evidence only
worked_examples.ask: Adopt this reviewed evidence packet into my herb bed record.
worked_examples.given: From tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/test/test_adoption.py (test_the_cli_adopts_without_deadlocking_on_the_library_lock), run for real on its made-up greenhouse library and 2 made-up frames: the input is {"schema": "source_evidence_adoption@1", "piece": "beds/herb-bed", "leaf": "review", "spec_path": "SPEC.json", "question_id": "QN-099", "journal_path": "admission/PAGE-READBACK.json", "evidence_paths": ["manifest.json", "EXTRACTION-READBACK.json", "PAGE-01-OBSERVATION.json", "PAGE-01-READBACK.json", "contact.jpg", "admission/PAGE-READBACK.json"], "appended_scope": "Bounded page evidence with structural joins only.", "evidence_note": "A bounded packet was validated; full coverage stays open."} plus the spec's before_spec_identity. python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library <library> --schema <library>/schema.json adopt-window adoption-input.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Exit 0 and a JSON receipt: {"schema": "source_evidence_readback@1", "piece": "herb-bed", "question_id": "QN-099", "question_state": {"status": "asked", "label": "Seen", "defect": false, "caught_by": []}, "shots_tsv_before": null, "source_review_kind": "finalized-pages", "exact_byte_inverse_verified": true, ...} with the journal, before_spec, after_spec, before_investigation and after_investigation identities, adopted_evidence, scope_appended and receipt_path. Only the spec's evidence member changed; the question stays asked.
